full_prompt_en: A square monochrome emblem rendering shows a large embossed silver-gray shield containing the letters “WB” on a completely black background. The shield is centered and occupies most of the middle of the frame, leaving a generous even margin of darkness around every side. Its upper edge forms a shallow pointed arch, the sides descend in rounded curves, and the lower edge closes at a narrow point. A thick outer rim follows that shape, its upper left and upper right segments catching pale gray highlights while the lower sections fade into charcoal. Inside the border, the tall W rises on the left with narrow tapering strokes and sharp inner wedges. The B fills the right half with a strong vertical stem and two broad rounded bowls. The letters overlap the dark recessed ground and appear to be raised from it, not printed flat. Cool gray light brushes the front faces, while deeper shadows accumulate along the right and lower edges of each raised stroke. Fine horizontal grain and a slightly brushed metal texture are visible across the bright surfaces; the recesses are smoother and much darker. The top of the shield has a thin secondary outline just inside the outer rim, giving the boundary another shallow layer. No other typography, object, setting, or color breaks the surrounding black field. The lighting is controlled and directional from the upper left, making the emblem's relief legible through narrow edge glints and soft metallic gradients. The overall composition is spare and symmetrical in its placement, with the irregular letter shapes held by a stable shield outline and a restrained silver-to-black range.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色徽记渲染在完全黑色的背景上呈现一枚大型银灰浮雕盾牌，内部可清楚读出字母“WB”。盾牌居中，占据画面中部大半，四周留下宽裕且均匀的黑暗边距。上缘形成浅浅的尖拱，两侧沿圆弧下降，下缘收于狭窄尖点。厚外框沿此形状环绕，左右上段接住浅灰高光，下段则渐沉入炭色。边框内部，高高的W位于左侧，笔画狭窄而逐渐收尖，内部留有锐利楔形空隙。B填满右半，有坚实竖笔和两个宽圆的字腹。字母从深色凹底上隆起，显然不是平面印刷。冷灰光擦过正面，而更深的阴影积聚在每段凸起笔画的右缘与下缘。明亮表面可见细横向颗粒和略带拉丝的金属纹理；凹处更平滑且暗得多。盾牌顶部在外框内侧还有一圈细薄次轮廓，使边界多出一层浅浮雕。没有其他字体、物件、环境或颜色打断周围黑底。光线受到控制，从左上方定向照来，让窄边亮光和柔软金属渐层共同显出徽记的浮雕。整体构图位置简洁而对称，不规则的字母形状被稳定盾形轮廓与克制的银黑色域收束。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome relief rendering places a single sculpted form within generous absolute-black negative space. Cool silver-gray faces carry faint brushed grain, while beveled edges catch narrow highlights and recessed planes fall quickly to charcoal. Broad simple geometry is made dimensional through controlled gradients rather than busy ornament. Crisp edges define the outer silhouette, but light softens gently across the raised front surfaces, suggesting solid metal. The central arrangement is balanced and nearly symmetrical, with an inner rhythm of angular and rounded strokes adding variety. One upper-side light source makes every highlight and shadow consistent. The overall visual effect is austere and authoritative, with tactile metallic relief isolated by deep darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色浮雕渲染将单一雕塑般的形体置于宽裕的纯黑负空间里。冷银灰正面带微弱拉丝颗粒，斜切边缘接住狭窄高光，凹陷平面迅速沉入炭色。宽阔简单的几何依靠受控渐层获得立体感，而不靠繁忙装饰。清晰边缘界定外侧剪影，光在隆起正面柔和跨过，暗示坚实金属。中央布局平衡且近乎对称，内部由尖角与圆弧笔画形成变化节奏。来自上方一侧的光源使所有亮暗关系一致。整体视觉效果严峻而有权威感，有触感的金属浮雕被深沉黑暗孤立出来。
